seo.title: Our services | Trace Brand Building
seo.description: Explore brand strategy, identity and campaign services from Trace Brand Building.

blocks.title: A clearer picture before we begin.
blocks.body: A few practical answers to help you prepare for a conversation.

blocks.title: What would you like to know?

items.title: Where should we start?
items.body: Start with the business challenge. Share what you want to change, who your audience is and what your brand needs to achieve.

items.title: Can you work with an existing brand?
items.body: Yes. Brand experience and refresh work can retain established elements while addressing what needs to evolve.

items.title: Can you help with identity and campaigns together?
items.body: The service offering covers both brand development and brand awareness. We can discuss a connected scope or a phased project.

items.title: How long does a project take?
items.body: Timing depends on the scope, deliverables and review process. A schedule should be agreed before the work begins.

items.title: What does a project cost?
items.body: Fees depend on the agreed brief. Request a proposal that sets out deliverables, exclusions and payment terms.

items.title: How are revisions and extra work handled?
items.body: The quote should specify included revisions. Changes beyond the agreed scope should be discussed and priced before proceeding.

items.title: Are there ongoing website costs?
items.body: Hosting, maintenance and any licensed assets or services may involve separate costs. Confirm these in the proposal.

items.title: Can I see relevant project examples?
items.body: Visit Our work and Case studies, then tell us which business challenge is closest to yours.
